{{Quote|I can tear apart a hyperdrive superconductor coil blindfolfed and can calibrate your engine displacement ration with a rabid bantha tied to my feet.|Brombek|<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
A '''hyperdrive superconductor coil''' was a component of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] [[Brombek|"Slide" Brombek]] claimed to be able to take a hyperdrive superconductor coil apart blindfolded.<ref name="SWTSE" />
